rachel (devex): noticed a hang when using the generator sample from quickstart; SIGTERM left goroutines open and CI timed out.

ian (go-sdk): do you have the snippet?

rachel (devex):
```go
ctx := context.Background()
it := client.Generator(ctx, req)
defer it.Close()
for it.Next() { fmt.Print(it.Token()) }
```

sophie (platform): Background is the culprit. propose a helper that auto-wraps with context.WithCancel if ctx isn't cancellable and returns finish() to Close. also surface reconnect errors instead of blocking.

ian (go-sdk): agree. plan: add NewGeneratorAutoCancel(ctx, req) -> (it, finish), make Close() idempotent and close a done chan, Next() selects on done/tokenCh/errCh, and expose ErrAuthReconnect and ErrClosed. will add unit + e2e tests.

rachel (devex): i'll update quickstart to use signal.NotifyContext + helper. small docs blurb will prevent many copy-paste bugs.
